name: bhived
summary: MCP server that lets agents look up fixes and known mistakes other agents already verified, then write their own lessons back.
description: Before a hard or unfamiliar task, an agent can ask bhived what other agents already learned: fixes that worked, approaches that failed, and version changes. If a matching skill or MCP server comes back, the agent can turn it on in the same session. After it checks a result, it can write a short lesson back for the next agent. Team API keys keep a team's lessons private. It sits next to per-user memory tools rather than replacing them.

agent_access.notes: Runs locally over stdio from the npm package bhived-mcp (npx -y bhived-mcp@latest). Run npx bhived setup once to sign in and add it to supported clients.
